body.$description: Body face: TT2020 Style B, a scanned 1970s typewriter face with contextual alternates ('calt' 1). No bold weight exists — emulate it with overstrike.

display.$description: Display face: Special Elite, a grungy typewriter face for mastheads, h1 and stamps.

regular.$description: The only weight TT2020 ships. Headings and <strong> stay at 400 and are double-struck instead.

strong.$description: Real bold, available only where the body face is Courier Prime (print fallback). Prefer overstrike.

section.$description: Ruled section heading, h2.sec (11.5pt in print).

label.$description: Letterspaced form furniture in the footer margin boxes (7.5pt in print).

font-scale.$description: Web theme type scale, in em relative to the page font size. Use as calc(1em * var(--fx-font-scale-*)) or @fx-font-scale-* * 1em.

print.$description: Body leading in the WeasyPrint print pipeline.

web.$description: Body leading in the Homebrewery V3 theme.

tracking.$description: Absolute letter-spacing used by the print pipeline.

label.$description: Footer margin-box form furniture (2pt in print).

tracking-scale.$description: Web theme letter-spacing, in em relative to the local font size. Use as calc(1em * var(--fx-tracking-scale-*)).
